description: This is a test source file for the class 'BaseRetireHandler', containing unit tests for its behavior in handling retirement operations on 'Retireable' entities such as 'Location'. It uses the JUnit 5 testing framework.

classes.name: BaseRetireHandlerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying the behavior of the 'BaseRetireHandler' class methods related to retiring entities.

methods.name: handle_shouldSetTheRetiredBit
methods.description: Tests that handling retirement sets the 'retired' flag to true.

methods.name: handle_shouldSetTheRetireReason
methods.description: Tests that the retire reason is properly set when handling retirement.

methods.name: handle_shouldSetRetiredBy
methods.description: Verifies that the 'retiredBy' field is correctly assigned when a user is provided.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotSetRetiredByIfNonNull
methods.description: Ensures that the 'retiredBy' field is not overwritten if already set.

methods.name: handle_shouldSetDateRetired
methods.description: Checks that the retirement date is set correctly.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotSetDateRetiredIfNonNull
methods.description: Verifies that an existing retirement date is not overwritten.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotSetTheRetireReasonIfAlreadyVoided
methods.description: Ensures that no retire reason is set if the entity is already marked as retired.

methods.name: handle_shouldSetRetiredByEvenIfRetiredBitIsSetButRetiredByIsNull
methods.description: Verifies that the 'retire reason' is set even if the entity is already marked as retired, but 'retiredBy' is null.
